Context

iOS 7 was announced on 10 June 2013 and released on 18 September 2013. It “introduced a completely redesigned user interface, a design credited to a team led by Apple’s former senior vice president of design, Jony Ive” (Wikipedia: iOS 7).

Wikipedia quotes the redesign as “sharper, flatter icons, slimmer fonts, a new slide-to-unlock function, and a new control panel that slides up from the bottom of the screen”.

Ive: “There is a profound and enduring beauty in simplicity, in clarity, in efficiency.”

Wikipedia’s article on Letterpress states that Ive took inspiration from minimalist iOS apps, among them Letterpress, for the iOS 7 graphics.

Why it belongs

The style record lists Helvetica Neue as the iOS 7 face and treats iOS 7 as part of the flat turn. Its blurred panels also point toward glassmorphism.
